_comment: Grade 3 activity-pack lines (every maths, English Home Language, Life Skills and English First Additional Language pack whose id matches *.grade3.*), rendered from the pack JSONs under lessons/curriculum/CAPS/*/r3_packs/grade3/ by voice_batch/r3_lines.py. All four grade batches and r3_packs_4_praise.json share one agent branch, so the merge job folds them into one r3_manifest and one agent PR. Only one batch renders per run: the daily scan picks the first (sorted) batch with lines still pending, so these run in order R, 1, 2, 3, praise.
